full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph shows a dark-haired person standing amid the wreckage of a damaged wooden building. The person occupies the lower center and right, wearing a long dark coat that merges into the deepest tones of the frame. Their head turns back and upward toward the left, with strands of uncombed hair partly covering the forehead and eye. The pale face is clear against the darker coat and rough background, giving the expression a startled, searching quality. Behind them, a two-story timber building fills the upper right. Its siding is scarred and uneven, window openings are dark and empty, and a damaged roof structure exposes beams near the top. At the upper left, broken supports and a drooping sheet or cable cut across a bright white sky. The middle ground is littered with splintered boards, collapsed planks, and other debris around the building. In the foreground, cracked ground and scattered long pieces of wood run diagonally toward the lower edges. The camera is at about the person's height, but wide framing gives the ruined setting substantial presence. Flat overcast light brightens the sky and the face, while deep blacks define openings, coat folds, and debris gaps. Grain and slightly rough focus make the photograph feel immediate rather than polished. The composition holds the person against a complex field of broken diagonal lines; the relatively smooth face becomes the visual anchor among the damage. No readable writing appears on the walls or debris. The overall image is stark and unsettled, using monochrome tonal contrast and close human scale to make a devastated place feel personal.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实照片呈现一名深发人物，站在受损木楼的残骸间。人物占据下部中央和右侧，穿着长深色外套，融进画面最深的色调。头回转并向左上抬起，凌乱发丝部分遮住额头和眼睛。浅色面孔在较暗外套和粗糙背景前清楚可见，使神情带惊惶而寻找的意味。后方一座两层木楼填满右上部。外墙板带伤痕且不平整，窗洞黑而空，受损屋顶结构在顶部露出梁木。左上方，断支架和下垂布片或电缆横过白亮天空。中景散满碎木板、倒塌板条及建筑周围的杂物。前景破裂地面和散落长木片斜向下缘延伸。相机高度接近人物，但宽取景让废墟环境占据可观面积。平坦阴天光提亮天空和面孔，深黑则界定开口、外套衣褶和瓦砾间隙。颗粒与稍粗糙的焦点使照片有即时感而非抛光感。构图把人物放在复杂的断裂斜线之间；相对平滑的面孔成为破坏中的视觉锚点。墙和瓦砾上没有可读文字。整体图像严酷而不安，以单色明度对比和近人的尺度让毁坏之地显得切身。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography uses rough grain, deep shadow, and a pale overcast sky to keep difficult surface detail readable. Fine broken lines and jagged diagonals fill much of the frame, while a smoother high-value focal plane offers a place for the eye to rest. Mid-gray textures remain present rather than being crushed into uniform black; the darkest passages mark gaps, openings, and close fabric folds. Light is diffuse from above, producing few hard cast shadows but strong silhouette separation. The framing is close enough for an intimate focal point yet wide enough to retain environmental context. Slightly imperfect focus and tonal unevenness lend immediacy to the image. The composition does not tidy away disorder; it organizes it through one clear face-level accent and contrasting lines of sight. The overall effect is stark, urgent, and humane, with material damage and human presence sharing the same visual weight.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影利用粗颗粒、深影和浅亮阴天天空，让困难的表面细节仍可辨认。细碎断线和锯齿斜向痕迹填满大部分画面，较平滑的高明度焦点面则让视线有落脚处。中灰肌理保留下来，没有全部压成同一黑色；最深区域标出缝隙、开口和近处布料褶皱。上方漫光几乎不形成硬投影，却带来强剪影分离。取景足够近以保留亲密焦点，又足够宽以留住环境。稍不完美的焦点和不均匀影调赋予图像即时感。构图不把混乱收拾干净，而以一个清楚的面部高度重音和相对的视线方向组织它。整体效果严酷、紧迫而有人性，材料损伤与人的存在拥有相近视觉分量。
theme_en: A dark-haired person stands amid the wreckage of a wooden building
theme_zh: 一名深发人物站在木楼残骸之间
name: Stanley Greene
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
